responsibility: Implements serialization of Go package export data, including package/type tables, exported declarations, inlineable function bodies, initialization metadata, and SHA1 checksumming of the emitted stream. It walks exported objects and inline bodies to collect referenced globals, imports, and types, assigns stable type indices, writes escape notes and function-body references, and can direct the resulting bytes either into object-file sections through the backend or into strings for in-memory use.
same_name_distinction: Contains the executable export-data writer: version magic/checksum handling, traversal that collects exported references and imported packages, type-index assignment, and emission to backend sections or strings. Unlike export.h, this file performs the serialization and stream operations instead of just declaring the export API and support classes.
